scope: Fresh read-only causal audit of the exact M784/M533 r15 invocation failure. The audit did not execute or source the runner, did not invoke VCS, simv, vcs -ID, lmutil, a license server, or any HDL/EDA tool, and did not create or modify a result identity. It inspected the frozen runner, release, source and final-hammer packages; checked bash syntax; counted the two relevant definition/call spellings; proved the failure occurred before the live identity/license probe and atomic result mkdir; and audited why the M787 source hammer and M792 final hammer did not cover executable function-call closure.

root_cause.mechanism: The r15 additive rename incorporated M782 into the prerequisite function name at the definition and the first two calls, but the final pre-mkdir revalidation retained the earlier short spelling. Bash parses an arbitrary command word successfully under bash -n and resolves it only when execution reaches the call, so syntax-only review cannot detect this failure.

tool_and_license_boundary.note: The runner had read and SHA-checked the pinned VCS/lmutil/license-file executables/assets before the failure; it did not execute the VCS identity probe, query the license server, compile HDL, or run simv.

findings.title: R15 final pre-mkdir prerequisite call has no definition
findings.evidence: The exact runner contains one definition and two calls of verify_r13_failure_m770_m782_and_author_preflight_prerequisites, but line 1102 calls verify_r13_failure_m770_and_author_preflight_prerequisites, whose definition count is zero. The exact invocation therefore terminates before the license/VCS probe and before result mkdir.
findings.impact: The released R15 control flow is not executable and cannot authorize a functional conclusion. The exact R15 release is revoked and must never be retried, resumed, relabeled, or cited.

findings.title: M787 source-static hammer checked syntax and selected predicates, not definition-call closure
findings.evidence: M787 records bash_syntax_pass=true while its scope explicitly says it did not execute or source the runner. Its executable isolation test covers only the M770 Python heredoc. Bash -n still returns zero on the frozen broken runner because an undefined command name is syntactically legal.
findings.impact: M787's 100/100 source verdict is superseded for launch admission. Its unrelated SHA, predicate, UNIT_DELAY, protocol, claim-boundary and seal checks are not reinterpreted as false, but they are insufficient to release R15.

findings.title: M792 final hammer inherited the source blind spot and never dry-ran the exact pre-mkdir path
findings.evidence: M792's scope explicitly says it did not invoke or source the runner. Its independent_hammer.py executes only execute_real_heredoc(), enumerates SHA edges, and checks gate tokens; it does not parse every custom function definition/call or execute the pre-mkdir call sequence. It therefore authorized a release whose final revalidation command did not exist.
findings.impact: M792's exact-one-R15-attempt authorization is superseded and must not be reused. A final hammer for R16 must independently repeat both a complete call-closure audit and the stubbed pre-mkdir execution test.

hammer_miss_analysis.bash_n_limit: Syntax validation does not perform command or function name resolution.
hammer_miss_analysis.m787_executed_scope: Exact embedded M770 Python heredoc only, with sealed/missing-key/wrong-key cases.
hammer_miss_analysis.m792_executed_scope: Exact embedded M770 Python heredoc only; remaining runner checks are identities, SHA edges, literal/token presence, and read-only host gates.
hammer_miss_analysis.missing_review_axis: Complete custom-function definition/call closure plus execution of the exact pre-mkdir control-flow prefix up to a non-EDA sentinel.

r15_release_disposition.reason: The invocation did not reach atomic attempt publication, but the released command was exercised and its admission chain is unsound. Preserve it as immutable negative evidence and move only to a new additive identity.

required_additive_r16_source.repair_scope: Close the stale function rename and add executable static admission; no RTL, TB, SVA, macro-model, UNIT_DELAY, watchdog, coverage, protocol, environment, resource, terminal, or claim-boundary relaxation.
required_additive_r16_source.release_gate: No candidate/release authoring until a fresh source hammer independently proves the complete function closure and reaches the dry-run sentinel. No R16 execution until a fresh final hammer independently repeats both checks.
